description: 3_observed_dnfs.py define_model: in fixed mode finish_time_noise = sigma_finish_time_noise = 0.1 (the prior scale constant from line 487) instead of the MCMC posterior median; fixed_params at line 2096 never passes it. Mis-weights LogNormal vs Bernoulli likelihood components and mis-shrinks course effects in the full-data MAP. Fix: extract posterior median like the other hyperparams and pass via fixed_params.

title: nb 2: zero-truncation selection bias in reporting model
description: 2_dnf_reporting.py fits the DNF-distance BetaBinomial only on races with has_dnf==1 but never truncates the likelihood. Reporting races can have zero DNFs by chance (short races, small fields), so conditioning on n_dnf>=1 biases mu_logit_dnf upward and distorts beta_distance_dnf, worst at short distances. Derived p_reports inherits the bias. Fix: zero-truncated BetaBinomial via Potential subtracting log(1-P(Y=0)) per race; P(0)=B(alpha,beta+n)/B(alpha,beta).
close_reason: Fixed in analysis repo commits 76634f6 (nb2 truncation), 04ae5be (nb4 double-count), f4f3566 (nb3 noise). Stale cached traces quarantined with .stale-pre-audit-fix suffix; refits required.

title: nb 4: zero-DNF evidence double-counted (Potential + Bernoulli)
description: 4_unobserved_dnfs.py model_m5: zero-DNF courses get the marginal mixture Potential log(psi*(1-p)^n + (1-psi)) AND their results are included in the per-result Bernoulli(p=psi*p_i) likelihood — two marginalizations of the same data in one joint. Per-result version also wrongly treats the shared reporting indicator as independent. Fix: mask zero-DNF-course results out of the Bernoulli; keep the Potential as sole term for those courses.
close_reason: Fixed in analysis repo commits 76634f6 (nb2 truncation), 04ae5be (nb4 double-count), f4f3566 (nb3 noise). Stale cached traces quarantined with .stale-pre-audit-fix suffix; refits required.

title: P5.4: Censoring penalty approximation in notebook 4
description: Penalty -n_finishers[c]*log(E[P(finish)]) uses an expectation; bias depends on individual predictions. Replace with exact marginal likelihood (integrate P(finish|x_i) over observed finishers) or use posterior-predictive simulation to estimate bias.
notes: AUDIT 2026-06-11: two additional approximation defects in the same area of 4_unobserved_dnfs.py: (1) the zero-DNF mixture term (1-p)^n uses distance-only baseline p while the Bernoulli uses race-difficulty-adjusted p — inconsistent; (2) selection_correction Potential (lines 770-772) keeps only the -log P(finish) denominator and omits the pace-dependent numerator P(finish|pace_i), so it cannot correct slope bias in pace. Exact marginal or shared-latent (gamma*race_difficulty already exists) is the proper fix.

title: P5.3: Hierarchy identifiability in notebook 4
description: Three-level hierarchy (population to course to race) risks sigma_race collapsing to zero. Fit simpler 2-level version (no race level) and compare via LOO-IC using arviz.compare. Inspect posterior widths on sigma_race; if data does not support it, drop the race level.

notes: AUDIT 2026-06-11: notes were stale — nb 1 MCMC is already LogNormal (1_finish_times.py:297). Residual bug is the MAP stage (line 1030): Normal(mu=pace*d, sigma=finish_time_noise*d) where finish_time_noise is now the LOG-scale posterior median (~0.15, dimensionless), so the minutes-scale sigma is ~pace (≈10x) too tight and closure-course effects are under-shrunk.
